# Changelog

## Unreleased — 0.1.0

- Rust implementation, documentation and tooling licensed under MIT.
- Independent Rust implementation of the Maylily packing format.
- Arbitrary-precision string IDs, configurable epoch, radix and 0–64-bit fields.
- Explicit-time and blocking system-clock generation.
- Optional `serde` configuration support and Tokio-backed `async` generation.
- Optional `parse` support for timestamps, elapsed time, machine/generator IDs
  and sequence values using an explicitly supplied layout.
- Feature matrix, cancellation and reference-vector tests; reproducible local
  10,000-operation benchmarks.
- GitHub-hosted CI and a manually dispatched, dry-run-first release workflow.

No Rust version has been published.
